shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- source ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx vite.config.ts; printf '\\n--- AGENTS ---\\n'; cat AGENTS.md"

/bin/bash -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json').version\"; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr -iname 'README*' -o -ipath '*docs*INDEX.md' | sort | head -20; rg -n 'useYagr|YagrComponent|onDestroy|dataDelta|realtime|DataPlot' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/react node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '70,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; rg -n \"useTheme|const use.*Theme|type Theme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -30; rg -n 'Provider|ThemeProvider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/useTheme/useTheme.d.ts 2>/dev/null || rg -n 'export declare function useTheme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head; sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/mixins/batch-updates.d.ts; rg -n '_batch\\(|splice|incremental' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/react.mjs | tail -20; rg -n 'declare function sp|function sp\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'interface AxisOptions' -A80 node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | sed -n '1,110p'; rg -n 'interface Scale\\b|export interface Scale' -A35 node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/CpuLoadChart.tsx')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace(\"\"\"  return {
    points,
    theme: 'light' as const,
  };\"\"\", \"\"\"  return {
    points,
    theme: 'light' as 'light' | 'dark',
  };\"\"\")
s = s.replace(\"\"\"      cursor: {
        hideOnMouseleave: true,
      },
\"\"\", \"\")
s = s.replace(\"\"\"          precision: 0,
          suffix: '%',\"\"\", \"\"\"          precision: 0,
          values: (_self, ticks) => ticks.map((tick) => "'`${tick}%`),""")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/CpuLoadChart.tsx; printf '\\n--- App/main ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; printf '\\n--- git ---\\n'; git status --short 2>/dev/null || true"
